## Organisation of scientific events

- Co-chair, IUBMB Symposium *Modern Biotechnologies in Sustainable Development of the Danube Delta*, 31 May – 2 June 2016, Murighiol, Romania.
- Organising committee member: International Conference BioHub *Biological Sciences: Challenges & Perspectives*, 25th anniversary of NIRDBS, Bucharest.
- Organising committee member: MoDaSyS AlgoNano workshop *Algorithmic and Computational Methods in Biomedicine and Nanotechnology*, Bucharest.
- Organising committee member: workshop *Modern Biotechnological Advances for Human Health*, Bucharest.
- Organising committee member: 12th National Symposium with International Participation *Medicinal Plants – Present and Perspectives*, 6–9 September 2016, Piatra Neamț, Romania.
